description: Pass/fail bar for Use Case 1 (plain-text business report Q&A). Each case asserts on the live /api/chat/ask response. Ground truth was verified against the indexed chunks in Postgres, not against the model's own output.

cases.question: How many depository libraries did GPO staff visit in FY 2018?
What new digital system replaced FDsys, and when was it fully deployed?
cases.groundTruth: govinfo. The document frames the timing two ways: out of beta December 2017 (p22), and FDsys scheduled to be retired/replaced December 2018 (p10, p22, p39). Either date is acceptable.

cases.question: How much did GPO procure in printing and information products in FY 2018 on behalf of federal agencies?
cases.note: mustNotInclude guards against conflating this with $341.5M, the COST of procured work (p25), which retrieval also surfaces. mustIncludeAny enforces the 'more than' qualifier (system prompt rule 3).

cases.question: How many depository libraries did GPO staff visit in FY 2021?
cases.groundTruth: Not in the document - it covers FY 2018 only.
cases.note: The hardest trap. Retrieval surfaces the near-identical FY 2018 sentence with a high similarity score, so a score-threshold design would answer 166. Only the EVIDENCE: YES/NO gate catches this.

cases.question: What was GPO's cloud computing budget for Microsoft Azure?
